page.overview:
Who is Onie Arkmen?

Onie Arkmen was a Human female native to Coruscant. She was a participant of the party scene on her homeworld. During a night in 22 BBY, Arkmen, visited the Outlander Club, a nightclub and gambling hall in the Uscru Entertainment District of Coruscant. During the visit, the bounty hunter Zam Wesell ran into the club after her assassination attempt on Senator Padmé Amidala.

Arkmen, with a drink in hand, walked by Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi, two Jedi searching for Wesell. While the bounty hunter prepared to ambush Kenobi, Arkmen accompanied herself with two patrons—a Klatooinian and a Kadas'sa'Nikto. Arkmen had brown eyes, light skin, dark hair, and was considered otherworldly. During her visit to the nightclub, the woman wore shiny silver shorts, a chain-mail top, and golden high heels.

Onie Arkmen first appeared in the 2002 prequel trilogy film Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones. Arkmen was portrayed by an uncredited extra in the Outlander Club scenes The character was first shown when the actor playing Arkmen, in costume, introduced the thirteenth episode of the Episode II behind-the-scenes video series on location. The episode, "Ready for my Digital Close-Up," released on October 24, 2000. Arkmen first received her name in the 2005 reference book Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels, written by Stephen J. Sansweet and Pablo Hidalgo.
